notes.title: Ghostwire: Tokyo - Prelude - Update Version 1.02
notes.content:
This update for Ghostwire: Tokyo - Prelude fixes some bugs and updates the game credits.

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sound update / Audio changes
[*] Removed 'Touchpad' callout
[*] Art fixes (specifically, fixes an issue with KK's outline)
[*] Fixed issue with Ed's story ending
[*] Typeface update
[*] Other misc. bug fixes
[/list]
[h1]MISCELLANEOUS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated Bethesda credits
[/list]
